heading: DELIVERY AND ACCEPTANCE
clause_text: Deliverables shall be deemed accepted if Amazon fails to provide a rejection notice within 5 business days. Amazon's acceptance shall not be unreasonably withheld. ProdCo determines completion and conformity with specifications. Amazon waives its right to reject deliverables after the automatic acceptance period.
test_notes: Contains red flags: 'deemed accepted', 'acceptance not unreasonably withheld', 'ProdCo determines completion', 'Amazon waives right to reject'. Amazon should retain rejection rights.
